title: Fluke: Chance, Chaos, and Why Everything We Do Matters
author: Brian Klaas
engineRationale: Brian Klaas's core thesis is about human beings navigating chaos, the illusion of control, and how everyday micro-decisions ripple outward. The central figure is the modern Everyman trying to optimize an unoptimizable world—making Antidote's flat-vector character rig, kinetic typography, and symbolic motifs (ripples, orbits, mazes, clocks) the perfect visual engine.
